```artifact
Feature: Offline Consultation Payment and User Interface Requirements

  Scenario: Offline Consultation payments are vide
    Given the user is on the Offline Consultation payment page
    When the user initiates a payment
    Then the payment should be processed successfully

  Scenario: Credit/Debit/Net Banking enabled through a Payment Gateway
    Given the user is on the payment page
    When the user selects Credit/Debit/Net Banking option
    Then the payment gateway should be displayed

  Scenario: All screens are developed to work on a PC/Laptop
    Given the user accesses the application from a PC/Laptop
    When the user navigates through the application
    Then all screens should be displayed correctly

  Scenario: Error messages appear at the bottom and are self descriptive
    Given the user is on the registration page
    When the user submits invalid data
    Then an error message should appear at the bottom and be self descriptive

  Scenario Outline: The maximum size of error messages will be 80 Characters
    Given the user is on the <page>
    When the user submits <invalid_data>
    Then the error message should not exceed 80 characters
    Examples:
      | page               | invalid_data         |
      | Registration page  | very long invalid data |
      | Consultation page  | very long invalid data |

  Scenario: Buttons are used to make the navigation simpler
    Given the user is on the registration page
    When the user clicks on the "Next" button
    Then the user should be navigated to the next page

  Scenario: Patient Registration and Consultation Requests screens have bigger font size
    Given the user is on the Patient Registration page
    When the user views the font size
    Then the font size should be bigger to aid Elderly people

  Scenario: Consultation Requests screens have bigger font size
    Given the user is on the Consultation Requests page
    When the user views the font size
    Then the font size should be bigger to aid Elderly people

  Scenario: Exception error message is displayed “Symptom does not exist”
    Given the user is on the Consultation Requests page
    When the user enters a non-existent symptom
    Then the error message “Symptom does not exist” should be displayed
```
